dropzone.hint: Images, PDF, video, audio, DOC/DOCX, TXT, CSV, or RTF
dropzone.addHint: Click or drag to add more files

likely_ai.title: Likely AI-generated image
likely_ai.description: The automated model found a strong AI-generation signal. This file will be flagged for administrator review and is not treated as verified evidence.

likely_real.title: No strong AI-generation signal
likely_real.description: The automated model considers this image likely real. This is a screening result, not proof of authenticity; an administrator will still review its source and context.

inconclusive.title: AI-image assessment is inconclusive
inconclusive.description: The automated model could not classify this image confidently. The file will require administrator review.

unavailable.title: AI-image check is temporarily unavailable
unavailable.description: Evidence submission is paused because the required server-side AI screening could not be completed. Try again after the service is restored.

elevated.title: AI-generation metadata signal detected
elevated.description: The file contains a known generative-video tool marker. This raises risk but is not proof; an administrator must review the original and its provenance.

inconclusive.title: Video authenticity is inconclusive
inconclusive.description: No known AI-tool marker was found in the readable metadata. Absence of a marker does not prove the video is authentic; the fingerprint, representative frame, context, and source must be reviewed.

ela.title: Image Manipulation Check (ELA)
ela.disclaimer: This is an automated signal only, not proof — an admin will review it.

ocr.title: Document Text Recognition (OCR)
ocr.disclaimer: Results may be unreliable on handwritten documents — correct as needed.
